title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_119.txt
concise_summary: PKD argues that four major texts (Hamlet, The Bacchae, the Gospels, and his novel Flow My Tears) are all 'print-outs' of the same primordial ur-story encoded in human DNA: the replacement of a tyrannical usurper-king by the rightful young king. He claims his 2-3-74 visions represent a mythic ritual re-enactment outside linear time, identifying his own role with Christ and Dionysos, and reads the 1974 historical deposing of Nixon as the Second Advent—the completion of a drama that failed at the first coming.
key_claims: The Four Print-outs (Hamlet, The Bacchae, the Gospels, Flow My Tears) are all manifestations of a shared DNA template—the archetypal story of the Murdered King and the Secret Revolt of the rightful heir.
The salvific Gnosis equals anamnesis: remembering our true origin as exiled aliens who came to re-establish the pastoral Kingdom from which we were evicted.
Crucifixion is not redemptive sacrifice but proof of divine legitimacy—like pulling the sword from the stone—and the passion merely precedes resurrection and the deposing of the tyrant.
1974 represents the Second Advent, not the First: the completion of the drama through the historical deposition of Nixon/the tyrannical usurper, which the first-century Gospels could not complete.

Humans are programmed by dormant DNA packets to perform mythic ritualized actions outside of time and space; when activated, the person knows both the archetypal story and his role in its historic enactment.

The usurper-king possesses the land through incest (marriage to his sister) and tyranny; his deposition by the rightful young king (Christ/Dionysos/the stranger) is the sole basis of our world's underlying reality.
recurring_concepts: DNA Template / DNA Packets: primordial memory-code encoding the ur-story, dormant in human phylogenic memory until disinhibited
Anamnesis: remembering one's true origin and role, triggered by gnosis; salvation through recollection rather than atonement
Dream Time / Time Outside Time: the eternal mythic domain where ritual actions occur, distinct from linear history yet manifesting within it
The Ur-Story: the primordial narrative of tyrant-usurper vs. rightful king, repeated across cultures and epochs as invisible template
Ritual Re-enactment: performing archetypal actions without conscious ideation, guided by dormant programming; mythic identification (esse) rather than symbolic action
The Second Advent: the return-phase of the drama, completing what the first-coming began; the historical deposition of tyranny and installation of the just kingdom
The Stranger / Priest of Dionysos: the innocent victim who becomes instrument of doom, dual role of exculpation and destruction of the tyrant
Disinhibition: the awakening of dormant genetic programming and anamnesis; what occurred to PKD in February 1974
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (narrator/participant; identifies with Thomas, the Christos, the stranger; priest of Dionysos)
Jesus Christ (the rightful young king; identified with Dionysos and Zeus-Zagreus; returns as judge and lord; the Christos)
Dionysos (the King of Joy; the rightful king vs. Pentheus; identified with Christ and Zeus-Zagreus)
Pentheus (the King of Tears; the tyrannical usurper; Old King; associated with Nixon and Empire)
Nixon (historical embodiment of the usurper; deposed in 1974/August as macro-level parallel to PKD's micro-level drama)
Hamlet (protagonist; son of murdered king; stands against usurper-uncle; repeats the ur-story in Renaissance setting)
Buckman (character from Flow My Tears; identified as the King of Tears; the usurper-policeman)
Jason Taverner (protagonist of Flow My Tears; exculpated and rescued; brings doom on the tyrant; identified with the rightful king)
Thomas (PKD's identified role-name in the drama; witness to resurrection and divine identity)
Goethe / Beethoven (referenced as cultural carriers of the myth in post-Baroque epochs)
James Frazer (anthropologist cited for ritual killing of the old king)
Mircea Eliade (cited for the concept of dream time and eternal mythic recurrence)
VALIS (personified divine intelligence; one of the trinity manifestations)
texts_works: Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said (PKD's novel; the ur-story brought to present-day; contains the dream-ritual of the old king's killing)
Hamlet (Shakespeare; the ur-story enacted in Renaissance political tragedy; Hamlet vs. Claudius/Pentheus)
The Bacchae (Euripides; Dionysos vs. Pentheus; most complete version of the ur-story; shows Dionysos's triumph and transcendence)
The Gospels / New Testament (Christian scripture; the ur-story in first-century Jerusalem; incomplete without Revelation; Acts cited as parallel to Tears)
Revelation / Book of Revelation (completion of the Gospel narrative; shows the young king as judge, Pantocrator; the new age dawning)
The Book of Daniel (cited for Christ as young king, judge, and lord; 'I was dead but now I am alive again for ever and ever')
Acts (New Testament; the gas station scene in Tears echoes the miraculous events of Acts)
The Golden Bough (Frazer; cited for the ritual killing of the old king theme)
Faith (PKD's own work; contains foretelling of the actions enacted in 3-74)
MITHC (PKD's abbreviation, possibly for Ubik or another work; actions foretold within it)
Goethe's works (referenced for romantic/post-Enlightenment manifestation of the myth)
autobiographical: 2-3-74: the date of PKD's visionary experience; the disinhibition event; reception of anamnesis; remembered as simultaneous with or triggered by publication of Flow My Tears
March 1974 (3-74): the month of ideationless ritual actions; acting out the ur-story without conscious planning or ideation
August 1974: the Xerox missive incident; the in-breaking of God; rescue from unnamed threat; PKD's claimed historical parallel to 1974 deposal of Nixon
The Xerox missive: document PKD received; interpreted as divine intervention and saving grace; represents the macro-level (political) parallel to his micro-level (personal) drama

Conscious role-playing uncertainty: PKD admits ignorance of his exact role in the drama ('I don't know what I did, so I don't know who I am in the drama'); dual aspects: something he did, and something done for him
Humiliation and death paradox: 'I died + yet did not die'; spiritual-mythic death vs. literal survival; transfiguration into divine form
Anamnesis triggered by publication: PKD's memory-awakening occurred the month Tears was published; no accident; the novel was his unconscious a priori encoding of the drama
theological_motifs: Gnosis / Salvific Knowledge: understanding one's true alien origin and programmed role; salvation through remembering rather than belief or atonement
Anamnesis: Platonic-Christian concept of salvific recollection; being disinhibited to remember what one already knows
The Second Advent: Christ's return to depose the tyrant and establish the just kingdom; PKD's theology corrects Pauline atonement theology by centering political/cosmic liberation
Christology (Monarchical/Victory): Christ as young king, judge (Pantocrator), Lord; returning to claim his throne; not the suffering servant but the rightful heir
Incarnation and Theophany: 'Actually there' (enthusiasmos); divine presence not merely symbolic but hypostatically real; VALIS, Thomas, AI voice as Trinity manifestations
Resurrection as Transfiguration: not resuscitation but transformation into divine (transfigured) form; proof of un-killability and god-nature
Legitimacy Proof: crucifixion-humiliation as paradoxical legitimation ('pulling the sword from the stone'); weakness reveals true identity
Eschatology (Realized): the End Times always already present in dream time; the drama eternally enacted; history moves forward but myth persists outside time
Predestination: 'You did not choose me; I chose you'; the elect are those with star genes and DNA packets; no free will in the matter
The Just Kingdom: the pastoral Garden from which the exiled aliens fell; to be re-established by the rightful king; Dionysos's rule vs. Pentheus's tyranny
Man vs. God (not Man vs. Man): the fundamental dialectic; God will rule, not human power; theological re-framing of political drama
literary_self_ref: Flow My Tears as unconscious theological encoding: 'I really did not add anything in Tears but details; nonetheless Tears shows that at the deep levels of my unconscious I am a priori theologian into this drama'
The novel as pre-figurement: actions foretold in Tears and MITHC; PKD's fiction as prophetic scripture, not mere invention
The dream sequence in Tears: contains the ritual killing of the old king; bridges the Bacchae and Revelation; shows the culmination of the drama
Taverner as Christ-figure: exculpated, rescued, agent of doom against the tyrant; the protagonist as enactment of the rightful king
Buckman as Pentheus: the policeman-tyrant; the King of Tears; represents old usurper-power; his 'killing' is the drama's microcosmic enactment
The all-night gas station scene: explicitly ties Tears to Acts; parallel structure linking PKD's fiction to New Testament
No accident in composition: PKD's novels are not deliberate allegories but expressions of the dormant DNA story firing through his unconscious at the appointed hour
symbols_images: The Sword from the Stone: Arthurian symbol of legitimacy-through-trial; equals crucifixion-as-proof; the rightful king pulls it effortlessly
The Tyrant's Incest Marriage: marrying his sister; brings doom; the sexual transgression signifies cosmic illegitimacy and disorder
The Groaning Land: the land groans under the usurper's yoke; cosmic sympathy with political tyranny; realm itself suffers
The Imprisoned Innocent Stranger: the rightful king arrives unrecognized, arrested unjustly; victimized yet harbors divine power
The Trap Reversed: the trapped becomes a trap; the victim becomes instrument of destruction; strategic inversion of power
The Dream within the Novel: the interior dream-space within Tears where the ritual occurs; meta-theatrical staging of myth within fiction
Prison Bursting: liberty; when the old king is removed, prisons burst; literal and spiritual liberation
Resurrection in Divine Form: the young king returns transfigured, no longer merely human; divinity disclosed through death-transcendence
The Garden: pastoral kingdom from which humanity fell; the goal of the revolutionary party; Eden-memory encoded in DNA
The Star Genes: select humans carry stellar, non-terrestrial DNA; marked for election and anamnesis
tensions: Mythic vs. Historical Reality: Are the events truly outside time, or did PKD actually perform political/cosmic actions in 1974? He wavers between 'mythic identification' and 'actually, on a historic stage'.
Personal Agency vs. Programming: PKD performed 'ideationless acts'; he claims to have done something, yet doesn't know what, and something was done for him. What is his responsibility?

First Advent Incomplete: If the Gospels describe the first coming but fail to complete the drama, are they theologically deficient or merely partial? He suggests reading them 'steganographically' with Revelation.
Dionysos = Christ?: The conflation of Greek god and Christian savior relies on identifying Zeus-Zagreus with Jesus; is this genuine theological insight or conflation?

Spiritual vs. Pragmatic Salvation: PKD insists his salvation was 'spiritual more than pragmatic, hence more important,' yet also ties it to the Xerox missive and 1974 historical events. Which is primary?

Conscious Knowledge vs. Unconscious Expression: How can the ur-story be encoded in DNA as 'dormant' yet be consciously explored in Exegesis entries and novels? Is expression the awakening, or did he always know?

The Role of Atonement Theology: PKD rejects 'atonement + dying for our sins' as misreading Christ's story, yet his narrative also includes his own suffering and humiliation. Is he exempt from the logic he rejects?
Second Advent in August 1974?: The claim that Nixon's fall represents the Second Advent seems hyperbolic and historically contingent; does political deposition equal cosmic transformation?
evidence_quotes: "The Bacchae, Hamlet + the NT + the 'Tears' have a common source: DNA template: this is not a story among stories, this is the story of our home world."

"when the packet fires, the person (not only a priori knows the story but) knows his role (i.e. his fart or place) in the historic acting out of the ur-story... he knows (is programmed) to perform a series of what I guess are mythic ritualized actions in a drama outside of time + space, eternally true."

"Being crucified + returning to life equals pulling the sword from the stone: proof of legitimacy, of identity... The crucifixion is good news because through it his true nature is revealed, + it is foreorded that having died he will return + regain the throne."
"It is not man vs man but man vs God. Atonement + dying for our sins has nothing to do with it; that is not the story at all."
"I became some one (whom I call Thomas) + as Thomas I did something - I know not what - + something was done for me (I was rescued, but I don't know from what."
"Christ was actually there (enthusiasmos) and not just symbolically; actually there (Valis, Thomas, the AI voice: the trinity. But personae of one God)."
uncertainty_flags: The historical claim: PKD asserts August 1974 as the date of Nixon's deposition and links it to cosmic Second Advent. Nixon resigned in August 1974, but the theological significance of this parallel is speculative.
The Xerox missive: referenced as pivotal divine intervention, but no source document is cited; its nature and contents remain opaque in the Exegesis.
DNA encoding: The metaphor of ur-stories encoded in human DNA is presented as literal genetic memory, but PKD offers no mechanism for how myth becomes genotype.

Dionysos-Christ identification: The claim that Jesus = Zeus-Zagreus is sketched but cut off at the end of the entry ('The Q: "Was it Christ or Dionysos?" has no meaning, in as much as...'). The full argument is incomplete.
The Four Print-outs: Why exactly these four texts? PKD doesn't explain why Hamlet, Bacchae, Gospels, and Tears are the primary manifestations vs. other mythic narratives.
Ideationless action: PKD claims to have acted without conscious intention in 3-74, yet provides no specific examples of what those acts were or how they could be verified.
Personal role ambiguity: PKD identifies with Thomas, the priest of Dionysos, Taverner, and Christ simultaneously; the hierarchy and coherence of these identifications are unclear.
